answer: Every agent id must publish a nonce-chained work log: each job signs the previous hash, so an identity's reputation grows only through completed, verifiable work in sequence. Like a bridge built span by span, trust accumulates linearly, and copying the key yields a fable of parallel selves that all share one chain and cannot mint two blocks from one nonce. An attacker must split real compute at zenith cost, so sybils earn nothing and the log itself becomes the defense.
